semantics.timing: Pure combinational logic; outputs respond to current inputs without a clock or registered latency.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No state or initialization requirement; outputs depend solely on inputs.
semantics.bitwise_or: For i=0..2, out_or_bitwise[i] is a[i] OR b[i].
semantics.logical_or: out_or_logical is 1 iff either input vector is nonzero for binary inputs; use SystemVerilog logical OR semantics.
semantics.inverse: For i=0..2, out_not[i] is NOT a[i] and out_not[i+3] is NOT b[i].

numeric.widths: Bitwise OR is 3 bits, logical OR is 1 bit, concatenated inverses are 6 bits.
numeric.arithmetic: Boolean operations only; no arithmetic overflow, rounding, saturation, or truncation.
numeric.packing: Inverse b occupies [5:3]; inverse a occupies [2:0].

verification.compile: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, finite timeout.
verification.simulation: Exhaust all 8 values of a and 8 values of b; allow combinational settling and compare every output with case inequality.
verification.oracle: Build OR and inverse outputs using per-bit binary truth tables, and logical result by detecting a set bit in either vector.
verification.coverage: All 64 binary pairs include zero, maximum, one-hot, complementary, and equal vectors.
verification.timeout: External finite compile/run timeouts and a testbench watchdog.
verification.scope: Independent development checks only; no official evaluation or synthesis.
